description:
Summary:

Fix Inductor Triton codegen to use the correct dtype for block pointer
store casts when the output buffer is an inplace-mutated buffer.

The issue: [codegen_block_ptr_store_line](https://www.internalfb.com/code/fbsource/[5d85ce7b930d]/fbcode/caffe2/torch/_inductor/codegen/triton.py?lines=3435) uses
`V.graph.get_dtype(name)` to determine the `.to()` cast type for block
pointer stores. For inplace-mutated buffers (e.g., `_to_copy` producing
fp32 values stored into a bf16 gradient buffer), this returns the graph's
intermediate dtype (fp32) instead of the actual tensor dtype (bf16). The
block pointer element type comes from the actual tensor, so the cast must
match it.

The fix: when the buffer is in [self.args.inplace_buffers](https://www.internalfb.com/code/fbsource/[5d85ce7b930d]/fbcode/caffe2/torch/_inductor/codegen/triton.py?lines=3440),
use the dtype of the original input buffer ([buf.other_names[0]](https://www.internalfb.com/code/fbsource/[5d85ce7b930d]/fbcode/caffe2/torch/_inductor/codegen/triton.py?lines=3443))
which matches the block pointer element type.

Test Plan: buck2 run mode/dev fbcode//caffe2/test/inductor:test_block_ptr_store_dtype

Reviewed By: amruth-rivos

Differential Revision: D97311681
